text: ＊は　＊を　つかって　はりきり　だした！

patterns.name: 〜だす
patterns.explanation: だす stuck onto a verb stem means 'start doing', often suddenly. はりきり だした = 'started getting fired up'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins this action to the next, showing what led to it. ＊を つかって = 'used ＊ and'.
